key_impacts: Fukushima Daiichi reactor units were damaged.
Site entered an emergency situation following the accident before later stabilization.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated; about 1,100,000 m3 of treated water stored on-site by Oct 2018.
Spent fuel in Units 1–3 required removal planning and preparatory work.
Solid waste required management with storage and volume reduction facilities.
